camel_example: aliyun nas CreateProtocolService --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolType NFS --ProtocolSpec General --FileSystemId 'cpfs-099394bd928c0000'
description_en: Creates a protocol service for a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system. The creation process takes approximately 5 to 10 minutes
description_zh: 创建CPFS文件系统的协议服务，创建协议服务过程大约需要5～10分钟
kebab_example: aliyun nas create-protocol-service --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --protocol-spec General --protocol-type NFS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProtocolService

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the protocol service.

Valid values: General (default)
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务的规格。

取值： General（默认值）
parameters.name: protocol_spec

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the protocol service.

Unit: MB/s
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务的带宽。

单位：MB/s
parameters.name: throughput

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the protocol service.

Valid values: NFS (default). Only NFSv3 access is supported
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务的协议类型。

取值：NFS（默认值），仅支持NFSv3协议访问
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the protocol service. This value is displayed as "Protocol service name" in the console.

Limits:

The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The description must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务的描述。控制台中显示为“协议服务名称”。

限制：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the protocol service. The VPC must be the same as the VPC of the file system.

If the storage redundancy type of the file system is zone-redundant storage (ZRS), do not set this parameter. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务 VpcId，需与文件系统 VPC 保持一致。

当文件系统的存储冗余类型为 同城冗余（ZRS）时禁止设置该字段。其他情况，该字段必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID of the protocol service.

If the storage redundancy type of the file system is zone-redundant storage (ZRS), do not set this parameter. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务 VSwitchId。

当文件系统的存储冗余类型为 同城冗余（ZRS）时禁止设置该字段。其他情况，该字段必填
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request.

A dry run checks parameter validity and dependencies without actually creating the instance or incurring charges.

Valid values:
true: Sends a check request without creating the protocol service. The check items include whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and business limit dependencies. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, HTTP status code 200 is returned, but ProtocolServiceId is empty.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the instance is directly created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检。

预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、依赖条件等，并不会实际创建实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建协议服务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode，但ProtocolServiceId为空。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
